title: Command Center lightweight resource pressure history
description: Proves the fleet Resource view exposes bounded core-aware trends and expandable read-only process attribution from the typed pressure RPC.

open-resource-pressure.intent: Open the cache-first fleet Resource view where node pressure history is rendered.

dismiss-whats-new.intent: Clear the release overlay so the pressure dashboard remains visible and interactive.

wait-pressure-overview.intent: Confirm the overview exposes core-aware utilization and bounded ownership summaries.

open-and-assert-machine-details.intent: Press the selected machine Details through CDP and verify three real SVG history plots with core-normalized load.

assert-cleanup-preview.intent: Verify both entry points open the same impact review and intercept the explicit second-step confirmation before it reaches the gateway, using a clearly labelled UI-only candidate when the live filtered fleet has none.

probe-pressure-rpc.intent: Verify the typed read-only backend shape and health-event stripping before interacting with the UI.

prove-cleanup-contract.intent: Deterministically prove busy targets, changed targets, resolution failures, and unverifiable shutdowns fail closed without depending on live fleet occupancy.

probe-cleanup-safety.intent: Prove the live gateway rejects empty and missing exact targets without invoking a resource shutdown.

capture-pressure-history.label: Core-aware pressure history and expandable process attribution
capture-pressure-history.note: Reviewer evidence: bounded SVG trends, class pills, managed slot ownership, and sampler health
capture-pressure-history.intent: Record reviewer-visible proof of the lightweight resource pressure dashboard.

capture-cleanup-preview.label: Two-step idle resource cleanup impact review
capture-cleanup-preview.note: Reviewer evidence: selectable exact targets, exclusions, and an intercepted explicit second action; a clearly labelled UI-only fixture is used when no live target is eligible
capture-cleanup-preview.intent: Record the shared read-only preview used by both cleanup entry points before any shutdown action.
